title: Editors vote yes or no on steering proposals

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
Feature: Newsroom steering proposal votes
  Scenario: Editor accepts a proposed steering change
    Given I open the steering desk demo at 1280 by 900
    And I open the steering Proposals section
    When I vote yes on the proposal titled "Rename scaling category"
    Then the proposal status should become accepted
    And the vote should record an append-only accept decision

  Scenario: Editor rejects a proposed steering change
    Given I open the steering desk demo at 1280 by 900
    And I open the steering Proposals section
    When I vote no on the proposal titled "Link scaling category to benchmark entity"
    Then the proposal status should become rejected
    And the vote should record an append-only reject decision
